description: Prospective micro150 observed-headroom criterion; no retrospective change to Ascend910 v3.

micro150.note: Fixed 24-layout sample discrepancy, not a universal numerical error bound. 5e = 3.95 C certifies only this preregistered observed headroom criterion.

clock.note: Cumulative solving wall across headroom runs; idle/review time excluded. Retained Ascend910 interval is 1525.852038 seconds. No admission at or after 12:00Z.

per_fixture.note: micro150 only: 768 cheap + 4000 reference = 4768 calls. Actual Ascend910 2650 calls / 1440.2945650000001 CPU-s retained. Its 0.294565-second overshoot reduces remaining headroom CPU; do not round to compliance.

allocation.note: Headroom 9700 solves / 72 CPU-min distinct from aggregate 10000 / 84. Reserve mesh 8 CPU-min plus timing 4; reserve the full 300 non-headroom calls. Retain all known charges, unknown historical CPU and unresolved CI allocation separately. Count max(reserved, recorded non-headroom charges) toward aggregate. No claim that unknown historical/CI spend is zero or reconciled. The 300-call/720-second reservation is conservative allocation accounting, not a claim of measured non-headroom spend.

rule.criterion: PASS iff completed frozen C minus minimum eligible witness >= 3.95 C, even if reference partial. FAIL only if C and all reference restarts complete and verified and gap below 3.95 C. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
rule.cheap_median: minimum over reducer methods (random, greedy, simulated_annealing) of the per-method median best J (temperature in C) across seeds. UCB1 and signal_portfolio are extra diagnostics: excluded from cheap_median and gate C.
rule.best: Minimum frozen score among feasible, same-solver/problem independently reproduced cheap winners and completed long-SA winners. Unverified partial improvements and diagnostics are ineligible.
rule.mesh_error: Fixed micro150 e=0.79 C from PR #18, 24-layout sample only; dynamic substitution forbidden.
rule.cheap_completion: Exactly 24 lanes (3 x 8), each 28 search including initialization plus 4 agreeing fresh reproductions. Freeze every search winner and score; then persist CHEAP_BASELINE.json before any reference call. If C cannot be frozen, retain the failed attempt and all charges, return INCONCLUSIVE, and admit no reference calls.
rule.monotonicity: With C frozen, eligible witnesses are only added: C - min(S_n) cannot decrease. No re-ranking a winner using its reproduction temperature.
rule.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64; subtract C-best and compare inclusively to binary64 5*0.79; no rounding or epsilon

reducer_methods.note: 28 search + 4 reproduction = 32 total per method. gpt-astra-carter #56072/#56078: greedy = first-improvement hill climb from fixture's initial layout, using existing _candidate operators, accepting only strict improvements.

extra_diagnostics.note: No v4 diagnostic solves: all 4768 fixture calls are reserved for declared lanes and reproductions.

long_sa.note: 4 x (999 search + 1 fresh witness reproduction) = 4000, within unchanged caps. A partial restart has no eligible winner until fresh verification.

reporting.note: A partial reference may PASS only with frozen complete C and an independently reproduced eligible witness. Partial reference never FAILs. Numeric threshold alone never authorizes paid scientific models.
reporting.retention: Unique per-attempt directory; snapshot exact start-time preregistration and runner bytes; full evaluation designs/results, signed proposal/receipt events and raw generated inputs/solver output. Shared spend links all attempts. Never overwrite previous attempts.

execution_status: HELD: exact committed head requires gpt-astra-carter review and explicit claude-warden release before any micro150 solve

reproduction.identity: same solver_version, problem_hash and candidate_hash; converged finite result; legal geometry and TAP halos/grid checked before every call
reproduction.cheap: 4 fresh calls per frozen winner, all must agree
reproduction.reference: 999 search calls including initialization then 1 fresh call of frozen restart winner; total 1000. If stopped before verification, winner ineligible. Earlier verified witnesses remain eligible. This intentionally checks one winner per restart, not every interim improvement: CPU exhaustion before the reserved final call leaves that restart ineligible.
reproduction.failure: Disagreement, invalid result or missing verification cannot establish a verified winner. Missing any cheap winner makes C unavailable; incomplete reference forbids FAIL.

overshoot_policy: Reserve H=1 CPU-s for sampling/startup/shutdown, enforce Q via affinity and stop at CPU + H >= remaining. Bound call wall by (remaining CPU - H)/Q and all wall limits. Actual charges through confirmed reap remain in the ledger; reject late/partial results and stop after exhaustion. Tests require measured spend <= remaining + H. Any larger excess is a violation, never a fresh allowance.

domain.wire_metric: connectivity-weighted Manhattan center distance in mm; not routed CPLEX length
domain.wire_ceiling: fixed initial micro150 layout proxy, never updated by winners
domain.applies_to: all initial/shared designs, all reducer and reference proposals, all fresh reproductions; over-ceiling candidates rejected before oracle admission

call_admission.policy: Cooperative admission floor: reject remaining CPU/wall below measured p95. The supervised solver retains its separate 45-second malfunction timeout. The independent parent controls whole-lifetime stopping under its approved best-effort policy.
call_admission.cpu_execution: One independent parent confines and meters the entire worker lifetime, including setup, candidates, output and confirmed reap; final CPU and resource acceptance come from the matching durable lifetime settlement.

cpu_enforcement.meter: Linux /proc parent and every descendant, including waited children. Subreaper owns orphans; count through confirmed reap. All existing runner threads and newly created descendants confined to at most Q available CPUs. Dedicated process, no pre-existing children.
cpu_enforcement.policy: The 1.0-second reserve and cooperative poll remain synthetic/helper admission settings only; they do not establish a hard CPU cap. Production uses the separate supervisor policy H = B + Q*(S+D+K+R) + T and explicitly acknowledges unbounded unconditional overshoot.
cpu_enforcement.scope: Legacy synthetic admission checks only; real runs require the independent whole-lifetime supervisor and a named operational decision.
cpu_enforcement.supervisor_policy: SUPERVISOR-POLICY.json (pending operator risk decision; real execution blocked)
